How to use this overview

Read the topics in the scheduled order. Open a draft to review it, and use a chapter as a finished lesson once you have approved it. This overview is a map, not a substitute for the full lesson. The English allocation is for IELTS grammar, reading, and listening. Past entrance-exam booklets are reserved for joint study in the final month.
